## Description

**What**: Update project docs for the CodeQL + code-quality scanning gates feature.
**Why**: New config knobs and CI jobs are introduced; reference docs must stay in sync.
**Scope**:
- IN: document require_codeql / require_code_quality in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md (incl. the Knob Lifecycle Owner / onboarding CREATE-owner note); document the CodeQL job + code-quality SARIF job in CI-INTEGRATION.md.
- OUT: new standalone docs unless a router gate directs to an ADR; direct CLAUDE.md edits (Gate 5 requires a CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, doc updates exist for every router gate that fired (config knobs, CI jobs) and the completion report includes the DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION block
  ← Satisfies: sc-3  (sc-3: "provision-ruleset.sh extended with require_codeql and require_code_quality knobs ...")

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] Apply plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/doc-router.md gates before writing. CLAUDE.md edits require a CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report — do not edit CLAUDE.md directly.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, I want project docs updated for CodeQL + code-quality scanning gates
